title: Replace hardcoded ADMIN SQL literal with constant
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-007). HasAnyAdminAsync hardcodes 'ADMIN' as a SQL string literal instead of using the MemorySmithRoles.Admin constant. If the constant value changes, the SQL silently breaks.

File: MemorySmith.Storage/SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs (lines 433-445)
Confidence: 100%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
